deadline.value: International applicants: February 1 for Fall (September) entry, which is also the deadline for entrance-award consideration (Winter: June 1).
deadline.quote: International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) February 1 Winter (January) June 1 | Applicants must apply by February 1 in order to be considered for entrance awards in their first year.

also.quote: Application deadline to be considered for awards: February 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field and the program page does not mention one.

supervisor.value: You need a confirmed supervisor (a professor) and their support letter before applying; applications without faculty endorsement are not considered.
supervisor.quote: Applications without an endorsement from a faculty member will not be considered by the department admissions committee. | You must have a confirmed supervisor before you can be considered for admission.

also.quote: Supervisor support letter (must have secured supervisor support before applying; supervisor support letter will be requested within the application as a recommendation)

funding.value: All newly admitted students are considered for support; PhD students receive at least CAD 23,000 a year for four years (from grants, scholarships and TA work), subject to satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: PhD students receive a minimum of $23,000 per year for the first four years of their program. | Maintaining funding is contingent on satisfactory progress.

entry_route.value: A master's degree with a 3.0 GPA in the last two years is required.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree or equivalent from a recognized university
